Hello Jess,
This place is beautiful and I would love to stay here. My name is Jacob Henry Caron and I am a 25 year old travel nurse from Canada. I have been living in a share house back home for the past 3 years so I am accustomed to the work comes with it.
A couple extra fun things about me: Lists of things I enjoy: Barbecuing, live music and Scooby doo. Things I like less, the cold,  pigeons and Coca Cola.
